description: November 4 birthday meaning: Scorpio decan 2, birthday number 4, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a November 4 birthday falls in Scorpio, in the second decan, with Pluto as the sign's ruler and Neptune as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 4. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Scorpio is fixed and water.

sections.heading: November 4 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: The 4th of November combines a dreamy decan with a very grounded number. Eleven degrees of Scorpio falls under Neptune's sub-rulership, encouraging intuition and imagination, while 4 represents structure, effort and patience. Interpretively, that suits someone who gives shape to intangible things, whether through a craft, a carefully organised archive or a long creative project completed step by step.

On November 4 the Sun usually sits at about 11° Scorpio, in the second decan, where Neptune is the sub-ruler alongside Pluto. From 10 to 19 degrees of Scorpio, the sub-ruler is Neptune, modern ruler of Pisces. Early-to-mid November birthdays tend to soften the sign's intensity with intuition, imagination and empathy. These Scorpios are often seen as perceptive in an almost uncanny way, reading undercurrents in a room and drawn to art, healing work or spiritual questions. Neptune can blur edges, so feelings may be absorbed from others or idealised beyond recognition. The combination is powerful when grounded: deep emotional insight paired with compassion, used to help people face what they would rather not see alone.

sections.heading: November 4 in numerology
paragraphs: A 4th-of-the-month birthday gives a birthday number of 4, with no further reduction needed. In numerology the birth day acts as a supplementary number, describing practical talents that sit beside the Life Path. The 4 stands for the square: four walls, four seasons, a stable base. Anyone born on the 4th is often pictured as organised, trustworthy and good at turning plans into schedules. They tend to prefer a method that has been tested to one that merely sounds exciting. The growing edge for 4s is usually flexibility, letting the structure bend when circumstances genuinely change.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one November 4 birthday to the next: it is 22 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22.

sections.heading: Born on November 4: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 4 is the 308th day of the year (309th in a leap year). By November 23, 19 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Sagittarius.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by November 4, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on November 4 include Laura Bush (1946), Matthew McConaughey (1969) and Tony Abbott (1957).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 4?
faq.answer: November 4 is Scorpio in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Scorpio, which tradition links with Neptune.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 4?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 4 the Life Path is 22 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 4 for everyone born on the 4th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 4?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a November 4 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 4?
faq.answer: November 4 is also the birthday of Laura Bush (1946), Matthew McConaughey (1969) and Tony Abbott (1957). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
